text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo got badly injured, so I rushed
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Guuuuuh... It hurts...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She still looks in pain even after treatment.
What can I do to cheer her up—
choice_data_list: Let's find a way to cheer you up.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Then Turbo wants to run!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo won't lose to the pain!
Turbo wants to win the next race!!
choice_data_list: In that case, let's take a break for a while.
As long as you don't push yourself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Why, why, whyyy!
Running always cheers me up!
choice_data_list: If it's Twin Turbo, she can make a comeback even after she recovers

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So true!! Good job, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turbo is amazing,
so I can take a break and win right after!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Twin Turbo had to take a break
and rest for a while...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Got it!! Turbo will do her best!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, how much is "impossible"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling uneasy, I explained the limits of not pushing herself
and started with light rehabilitation—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
My Turbo engine might be broken...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
B-But Turbo won't give up
over something like th—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow ow!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hastily put a stop to her rehab
and had her rest. However,
it would take a long time before she could return...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Vroooooom!
The Turbo Engine is in top gear!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: If I'm with you, Trainer, we can keep going without ever stopping!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Twin Turbo's proactive rehabilitation,
she made a smooth return afterward.
